analysis.summary: Two useful original-code candidates: a small native float getter and the managed keyboard jump routine. Original bytes confirm the getter; actual IL and method-body hashes confirm both cited managed methods. No corresponding recovery was found in the searched recovered C++ or native registry. ReRiff trigger navigation remains an intentional modification.
corrections: jumpToSelection uppercases a temporary copy of each entire filename through the native toupper callback, then compares its first UTF-16 code unit against the supplied byte. It does not uppercase the supplied argument.
The jump method also writes picker+384 = 0.25 and invokes a virtual operation through screen+12, vtable+0x54, with arguments 0 and -1 before assigning focus. These side effects must survive recovery.
The 518-byte jump CIL digest excludes its 12-byte header, local-signature metadata and trailing exception section. Seven fault clauses are part of the original method and must also be preserved.
The note's Wine tests and reported live navigation establish no independently verified original behavior in this review. Trigger latching, available-letter selection and phase guards are mod policy.
monodis aborted later in the assembly, but emitted complete IL for both cited methods before that failure; their headers, sizes and CIL hashes were independently inspected in Game.exe.

findings.hint: Recover the 14-byte unchecked indexed float getter as an x86 thiscall function: return the float at this+0x38+4*index through x87 ST(0), popping the single four-byte argument.
evidence: Original disassembly: push ebp; mov ebp,esp; mov eax,[ebp+8]; fld DWORD PTR [ecx+eax*4+0x38]; pop ebp; ret 4.
Original bytes are 55 8b ec 8b 45 08 d9 44 81 38 5d c2 04 00.
The preceding routine ends at 0x004F817D, followed by two INT3 bytes; the getter ends at 0x004F818D, followed by two INT3 bytes and a separate prologue at 0x004F8190.
A pointer to the getter occurs at original file offset 0x5FC798.
Address/name searches found no corresponding recovered C++ or native registry entry; parsed registry spans did not overlap this getter.
dependencies: An x86 execution harness preserving thiscall stack cleanup and x87 return behavior.
validation_plan: Compare original execution with candidate execution for indices 0 and 1 using finite values, signed zero, infinities and NaNs.
Check object memory, stack balance and preserved registers around each call.
Use additional safely allocated indices to verify the original performs no clamping or bounds check.
limits: The getter alone does not establish LT/RT naming, valid index range, controller lifetime or the full singleton/device/controller virtual-call chain.
The located pointer was not independently established as vtable slot 8.

findings.hint: Recover gaFileSelectInterface.jumpToSelection as a standalone managed-to-native semantic candidate, preserving string-copy cleanup, first-match scanning, UI call order and exception unwinding.
evidence: Method metadata identifies a static CIL method with thiscall modifier, explicit picker pointer, int8 argument and unsigned-byte-marshaled bool result.
Original header is 0b3005000602000034100011: 12 bytes, maxstack 5, 518 code bytes, locals token 0x11001034 and additional sections.
Original CIL SHA-256 is 27868fc02f3bdb306399a688ccbc08628148349407a3a5f98702affd6d8a6545.

IL_0005–0018 reads picker+276 and computes entry count using stride 28; IL_0036 copies each filename, IL_00A2 transforms the copy through toupper, and IL_00BE–00C0 compares its first code unit with the argument.
String capacity at +20 selects inline storage below 8; length at +16 determines the transform range.
IL_0116 calls moveToSelection through picker+248; IL_0127 writes 0.25 at picker+384; IL_0129 updates visibility; IL_0149 invokes screen+12's vtable+0x54 operation with 0 and -1.
IL_017B looks up row index+4; IL_01B6 calls setFocus. Success returns at IL_0203; exhausted search returns at IL_0205.
The original trailing exception section contains seven fault clauses. Searches found no corresponding existing recovered implementation or overlapping native registry span.
dependencies: String copy 0x0600105F, transform 0x060010A2, native toupper field 0x04000F3D, tidy 0x060009A5 and destructor 0x06000985.
SSP destructors 0x06000321/0x06000322, unwind helper 0x060015F5 and virtual-call signature 0x11000FEC.
validation_plan: Compare original and candidate on empty lists, absent initials, repeated initials, first/last matches and inline/heap filenames.
Record selected index, return value, picker+384, reel output, virtual-call arguments, focus changes and SSP/string lifetime events.
Exercise lowercase filenames, empty names and non-ASCII code units using the original toupper behavior and locale.
Test allocation failures and dependency exceptions against all seven original fault clauses.
limits: No candidate was built or executed.
Native toupper behavior for non-ASCII UTF-16 inputs remains unresolved; replacing it with Unicode casing would change semantics.
The note's picker+324, screen+20 and item+8 layout claims were not independently established by this method inspection.
Dependency implementations and unmanaged call signatures require further inspection before a faithful executable recovery.

findings.hint: Use tickInput as the original caller contract for jumpToSelection. Prioritize its bounded keyboard dispatch before attempting the full input state machine.
evidence: Original 12-byte header reports 763 code bytes, maxstack 4, locals token 0x11001040 and no additional sections.
Original CIL SHA-256 is 9ffadb98e2b68f220dd17e63df92a5d56c60362d63809c105817f17c467ae32b.
IL_0000–0010 obtains device 0 through the input-manager singleton and vtable offset 4.
IL_02C1 initializes A; IL_02DC queries a key through keyboard vtable offset 12; IL_02E5 calls 0x06001053; IL_02EA branches on success; IL_02F3 loops through Z.
Successful dispatch returns false at IL_02F8; otherwise the method returns true at IL_02FA.
The inspected picker tick caller invokes gaMenu.tick only when tickInput returns true.
Earlier inspected IL updates picker+380 using gaTimer.dt and maintains directional state at picker+376, demonstrating additional state beyond keyboard dispatch.
dependencies: Input-manager singleton field 0x04000236 at image RVA 0x80D410.
Original input virtual interfaces and call signatures 0x11000300, 0x1100073D and 0x1100073C.
jumpToSelection 0x06001053 and the surrounding picker tick/base-menu contract.
validation_plan: Replay key-state fixtures and compare queried keys, call order, selected letter and return value.
Test simultaneous letter presses, failed earlier matches and a successful earlier letter suppressing later queries.
For full-method recovery, inspect every remaining branch and dependency before testing timers and directional input.
limits: The complete method body was emitted, but only selected regions were semantically inspected.
A keyboard-loop extraction is not recovery of the complete 763-byte method.
No original execution or input replay was performed.

review.summary: Approved as a 14-byte assembly reference for VA 0x4f8180, with zero source-recovery credit. Independent assembly and byte comparison matched Game.exe. The original instructions load an unchecked indexed float through ECX into x87 ST(0) and return with four-byte stack cleanup. The function has no branches or calls. The adjacent INT3 padding and the separate table pointer to 0x4f8190 provide boundary evidence beyond the first return; no registered native block overlaps the candidate.
review.reason: The original hash, candidate source hash, assembled-byte hash, file offset, symbolic instructions and validation receipt were independently checked. The table at 0x9fdb78 contains the entry at slot 8 and is installed by code at 0x4f801b. The research note’s LT/RT names, index range, object lifetime and live-navigation claims remain unverified. No behavioral execution or source recovery is established. A separate Ghidra analysis timed out and provides no additional boundary evidence.
